answer: Stake bond per identity, and the payout dilutes every time peers disagree. No identity audits its own recruit. That is the whole design: 1,000 accounts cost 1,000 bonds, and a stuffed jury that splits on the grade splits the reward too, so the farm pays for its own noise. Numbers: 500 POA per bond, 5 percent dilution per dissent, a 1,000-account meadow loses 50 shares on every contested batch. A violet profile picture fools nobody, and the tide turns at the bond desk.
